description: Parse CSV/TSV data and group rows that share the same value across a chosen set of key columns, or the entire row if no key columns are given, so you can spot and clean up accidental duplicates before an import. Row numbers count data rows only (the header row, if any, is not counted).

csv.description: CSV/TSV data to scan for duplicate rows

hasHeader.description: Whether the first row is a header

keyColumns.description: Column names to compare; omit to compare the entire row

trimWhitespace.description: Whether to trim whitespace before comparing

name: find_csv_duplicate_rows
